womens-health-integrative-care.title: Gynecologist in Khanvel – PCOS, Periods & Menopause Care
womens-health-integrative-care.description: Care for PCOS/PCOD, irregular or painful periods, white discharge, family planning and menopause at Shobha Hospital, Khanvel.

faqs.q: Do you treat PCOS / PCOD?
faqs.a: Yes. PCOS care at Shobha Hospital includes hormonal and ultrasound evaluation, lifestyle and diet planning, medical treatment where needed, and supportive Ayurvedic therapies to help regulate cycles and improve metabolic health.

faqs.q: When should I see a gynecologist for irregular periods?
faqs.a: See a gynecologist if your cycles are regularly shorter than 21 days or longer than 35 days, you miss periods for three months, bleeding is very heavy or lasts more than 7 days, or you have bleeding between periods or after menopause.

faqs.q: Do you offer menopause care?
faqs.a: Yes. We help with hot flashes, sleep and mood changes, bone and heart health, and lifestyle planning during perimenopause and menopause, combining medical evaluation with diet, yoga and Ayurvedic support.

faqs.q: Can I consult a lady doctor?
faqs.a: Our team includes women gynecologists and obstetricians, including online consultations. Mention your preference when booking and we will do our best to arrange it.

pregnancy-maternal-care.title: Maternity Hospital & Normal Delivery in Khanvel, Silvassa
pregnancy-maternal-care.description: Antenatal check-ups, scans, high-risk pregnancy care, normal & caesarean delivery and postnatal care at Shobha Hospital, Khanvel.

faqs.q: Do you prefer normal delivery?
faqs.a: Yes. We strongly support normal delivery whenever it is medically safe, with continuous labour monitoring. A caesarean section is advised only when it is medically indicated for the safety of mother or baby.

faqs.q: When should I have my first pregnancy visit?
faqs.a: As soon as your pregnancy test is positive — ideally by 6–8 weeks. The first visit confirms the pregnancy, dates it with an ultrasound and starts essential supplements and blood tests.

faqs.q: Which scans are needed during pregnancy?
faqs.a: Typically an early pregnancy scan (6–8 weeks), NT scan (11–13 weeks), anomaly scan (18–20 weeks) and growth scans in the third trimester. Use our free due date planner to see your own scan dates.

faqs.q: Do you manage high-risk pregnancies?
faqs.a: Yes — including high blood pressure, diabetes, thyroid disorders, twins, IVF pregnancies, previous caesarean and recurrent pregnancy loss, with closer monitoring and individualised care plans.

infertility-reproductive-health.title: Infertility Treatment in Khanvel, Silvassa | Shobha Hospital
infertility-reproductive-health.description: Step-by-step fertility evaluation for couples, ovulation & PCOS management and recurrent miscarriage care at Shobha Hospital, Khanvel.

faqs.q: When should we see a fertility specialist?
faqs.a: If you have been trying to conceive for 12 months without success — or for 6 months if the woman is over 35 — or earlier if there are irregular periods, known PCOS, previous pelvic surgery or male factor concerns.

faqs.q: Are both partners evaluated?
faqs.a: Yes. Male factors contribute to many cases of infertility, so we evaluate both partners together, including a semen analysis for the male partner.

faqs.q: Do you treat recurrent miscarriage?
faqs.a: Yes. We investigate possible causes of recurrent pregnancy loss and plan supportive care for the next pregnancy with close monitoring.

faqs.q: Is Ayurveda used in fertility treatment?
faqs.a: Ayurvedic therapies, diet and lifestyle guidance are used alongside evidence-based medical evaluation and treatment — never as a replacement for necessary medical care.

gynecology-surgical-care.title: Laparoscopic Gynec Surgery in Khanvel | Shobha Hospital
gynecology-surgical-care.description: Laparoscopy, hysteroscopy, fibroid & ovarian cyst surgery, prolapse care and safe caesarean sections in Shobha Hospital’s modern OT.

faqs.q: What is laparoscopic (keyhole) surgery?
faqs.a: Laparoscopy uses small incisions and a camera to operate. Compared with open surgery it usually means less pain, a smaller scar, a shorter hospital stay and faster recovery.

faqs.q: Which conditions can be treated surgically?
faqs.a: Common examples include ovarian cysts, fibroids, endometriosis, uterine polyps, uterine prolapse, ectopic pregnancy and certain causes of heavy bleeding or infertility, depending on individual evaluation.

faqs.q: Where are surgeries performed?
faqs.a: Surgical procedures are carried out in an established hospital setting under the clinical leadership of Dr. Sachin Ladak Shedad, with our surgical team. Our staff will share the details when your procedure is planned.

faqs.q: Will I need surgery?
faqs.a: Not always. We recommend surgery only when it is medically indicated, after explaining all options, risks and benefits so you can make an informed decision.

garbhasanskar.title: Garbhasanskar Program in Khanvel, Silvassa | Shobha Hospital
garbhasanskar.description: Garbhasanskar antenatal wellness — pregnancy diet, prenatal yoga, meditation, music and bonding — alongside modern obstetric care.

faqs.q: What is Garbhasanskar?
faqs.a: Garbhasanskar is a traditional Indian approach to supporting a mother’s physical, emotional and mental wellbeing during pregnancy through diet, yoga, meditation, music and positive bonding with the baby.

faqs.q: When should I start Garbhasanskar?
faqs.a: It can begin with preconception preparation, and most mothers start once pregnancy is confirmed and their obstetrician has cleared them for yoga and other activities.

faqs.q: Does Garbhasanskar replace regular check-ups?
faqs.a: No. Garbhasanskar complements — and never replaces — antenatal check-ups, scans, blood tests and medicines advised by your doctor.

faqs.q: Can the father join?
faqs.a: Yes. Involving the father and family in bonding activities and parenting preparation is encouraged.

panchakarma-therapies.title: Panchakarma Treatment in Khanvel, Silvassa | Shobha Hospital
panchakarma-therapies.description: Doctor-supervised Panchakarma — Vamana, Virechana, Basti, Abhyanga, Shirodhara — for detox, joint pain, stress and women’s health.

faqs.q: What is Panchakarma?
faqs.a: Panchakarma is a classical Ayurvedic programme of cleansing and rejuvenation therapies, planned according to your constitution, health condition and season, and carried out under medical supervision.

faqs.q: How many days does Panchakarma take?
faqs.a: It depends on the therapy and your condition — from single-day supportive therapies to programmes of one to three weeks. Your doctor will advise after consultation.

faqs.q: Is Panchakarma safe for everyone?
faqs.a: Not every therapy suits everyone. Pregnancy, certain medical conditions and age need special care, so every plan begins with an Ayurvedic doctor’s assessment.

faqs.q: Which problems can Panchakarma help with?
faqs.a: It is commonly used as supportive care for joint pain and arthritis, stress and sleep problems, digestive and lifestyle disorders, skin conditions and hormonal balance.

basic-pediatrics.title: Child Specialist & Suvarna Prashan in Khanvel | Shobha Hospital
basic-pediatrics.description: Newborn care, immunisation guidance, Suvarna Prashan, growth & nutrition monitoring and common childhood illness care in Khanvel.

faqs.q: What is Suvarna Prashan?
faqs.a: Suvarna Prashan is a traditional Ayurvedic preparation given to children, usually on Pushya Nakshatra days, to support immunity and overall development. It is given only after assessment by our paediatrician.

faqs.q: Do you guide on vaccinations?
faqs.a: Yes. We counsel parents on the national immunisation schedule and recommended optional vaccines, and help you keep track of due dates.

faqs.q: Do you treat common childhood illnesses?
faqs.a: Yes — such as fever, cough and cold, diarrhoea, skin problems and feeding difficulties — along with growth, nutrition and development monitoring.

holistic-wellness-preventive-care.title: Yoga, Diet & Preventive Health in Khanvel | Shobha Hospital
holistic-wellness-preventive-care.description: Preventive health check guidance, yoga therapy, weight & diet planning, stress management and lifestyle disease prevention.

faqs.q: Do you offer yoga therapy?
faqs.a: Yes. Personalised yoga and pranayama programmes are planned by our yoga and preventive medicine specialist for stress, weight, metabolic health, women’s health and fertility.

faqs.q: Can you help with weight loss and diet?
faqs.a: Yes. We create practical diet and lifestyle plans based on your health, routine and food habits, with regular follow-ups.

faqs.q: Who should consider preventive care?
faqs.a: Anyone with a family history of diabetes, high blood pressure or heart disease, a sedentary lifestyle, high stress, or anyone who simply wants to stay healthy as they age.

andrology-male-infertility.title: Male Infertility Treatment in Khanvel | Shobha Hospital
andrology-male-infertility.description: Semen analysis, hormone evaluation and integrative treatment for low sperm count and sexual health concerns — confidential care.

faqs.q: What is the first test for male infertility?
faqs.a: A semen analysis, which checks sperm count, movement (motility) and shape (morphology). Hormone tests and other investigations may follow depending on the result.

faqs.q: Can low sperm count improve?
faqs.a: Often, yes. Sperm take about three months to develop, so treating underlying causes and improving lifestyle — stopping smoking and alcohol, healthy weight, diet and avoiding heat — can improve results over a few months.

faqs.q: Is the consultation confidential?
faqs.a: Yes. Andrology and sexual health consultations are handled with complete privacy and sensitivity, without stigma or blame.

faqs.q: Is Shobha Hospital open 24 hours for emergencies?
faqs.a: Yes. Emergency services are available 24×7, every day. Call +91 97142 06386 and come straight to the hospital at Khanvel Char Rasta.

faqs.q: Where is the hospital?
faqs.a: Shop No. 16–17, ND Complex, Khanvel Char Rasta, Silvassa, Dadra & Nagar Haveli 396230 — use the “Get directions” button on our website.

faqs.q: Can I come directly in labour at night?
faqs.a: Yes. The labour room and obstetric team handle deliveries at any hour. Calling ahead helps the team prepare.

faqs.q: Do you have an ambulance or ICU?
faqs.a: A 24×7 ambulance and an advanced ICU are coming soon and are not available yet. Please call to confirm current services.

emergency-care.title: 24×7 Emergency Hospital in Khanvel, Silvassa | Shobha Hospital
emergency-care.description: 24×7 emergency services, labour room and operation theatre at Khanvel Char Rasta, Silvassa. Emergency: +91 97142 06386.

faqs.q: Do you treat general illnesses, not only women’s health?
faqs.a: Yes. Shobha Hospital is a multi-speciality family hospital — our doctors treat fever, infections, BP, diabetes, thyroid problems and common skin conditions.

faqs.q: Which surgeries are done at the hospital?
faqs.a: Common procedures include hernia repair, gallbladder surgery, lipoma and cyst removal, and treatment of piles, fissure and fistula, in the hospital’s modern operation theatre.

faqs.q: What is laparoscopic surgery?
faqs.a: Laparoscopy (दूरबीन विधि) uses small cuts and a camera. Compared with open surgery it usually means less pain, a smaller scar and faster recovery.

general-medicine-surgery.title: General Physician & Surgeon in Khanvel | Shobha Hospital
general-medicine-surgery.description: Fever, infections, BP, diabetes, skin problems, hernia, gallbladder, piles and laparoscopic surgery at Shobha Hospital, Khanvel.

faqs.q: Is there a lab inside the hospital?
faqs.a: Yes. Shobha Hospital has an advanced pathology laboratory on site, so most tests advised by our doctors can be done in the same visit.

faqs.q: Do I need to fast before blood tests?
faqs.a: Some tests, such as fasting blood sugar, need fasting. Ask our team when you book so you can come prepared.

faqs.q: Are X-Ray and sonography available?
